testcase.name: a future choice retains its own date and becomes current across the start boundary
tomorrows selected service keeps tomorrows context while still upcoming
accepted zone aliases compare against the canonical zone emitted by overview
clock moving backwards changes relation but keeps the same selected occurrence
current stage is recomputed at click time instead of taking the old snapshot
an expired selected service is never silently replaced by another current or next service
a late evening occurrence preserves yesterday as its service date after parish midnight
title editing does not create a different occurrence while removal and date corruption do
switching parish or its timezone rejects a stale card even with similar labels
personal time changes and source changes invalidate the selected card
